summary.text: Peter Durant is a Republican state senator who has represented the Worcester and Hampshire District since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He faces Democrat Shannon Teabo and served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2011 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Peter Durant earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Northeastern University.
His professional experience includes work as vice president of service for Yankee Technology in Ludlow, Massachusetts, and as a small business owner.
Durant represented the 6th Worcester District in the state House from 2011 to 2023 and then succeeded Anne Gobi in the Senate.

In the 2025-2026 session he is the ranking minority member of the Senate Committee on Juvenile and Emerging Adult Justice, the Personnel and Administration Committee, and several joint committees, including Aging and Independence, Cannabis Policy and Public Safety and Homeland Security.
